chunks.title: IIGCC & Bloomberg Philanthropies Climate Finance Network (IIGCC / Bloomberg) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: IIGCC & Bloomberg Philanthropies Climate Finance Network is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in United Kingdom / United States. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: IIGCC is founding member of COP31 Electrify Now Finance Coalition; Bloomberg Philanthropies is official COP31 Action Agenda partner co-hosting Global Finance Summit. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Mobilizing institutional asset owners & philanthropic catalytic grants across clean electrification, zero waste, methane abatement & industrial transition at COP31. Source verification: https://www.bloomberg.org/press/cop31-presidency-and-bloomberg-philanthropies-announce-partnership-to-advance-climate-action-ahead-of-cop31-in-antalya/.

chunks.title: IIGCC / Bloomberg Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: IIGCC & Bloomberg Philanthropies Climate Finance Network provides the following climate financing instruments: Institutional Co-Investment Syndication, Philanthropic Catalytic Grant, Net-Zero Asset Owner Mandates, Project Preparation Support. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 1,000,000 to USD 200,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Large Corporate, Municipality, Climate-Tech Startup, Accredited Entity/NGO, Fund Manager.

chunks.title: IIGCC / Bloomberg Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by IIGCC & Bloomberg Philanthropies Climate Finance Network: Electrification & Grid, Renewable Energy, Methane Abatement, Zero Waste & Circular Economy, Ocean-Climate Action, Industrial Decarbonization. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Türkiye, Emerging Markets, Developing Countries. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: IIGCC / Bloomberg Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete IIGCC / Bloomberg's application form: Alignment with Net Zero Investment Framework (NZIF) or COP31 Action Agenda pillars; High scalability and institutional investor investability; Transparent emissions accounting & transition credibility; Public-private partnership or multi-level implementation impact. Explicit exclusion rules: Fossil-fuel expansion incompatible with 1.5C pathways. Official application portal: https://www.iigcc.org/.

chunks.title: IIGCC / Bloomberg Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: IIGCC & Bloomberg Philanthropies Climate Finance Network uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
